audit_items.proof_trace: All economically critical consumers apply staleness checks: the borrow/safety path uses `get_price_with_check` (EMA + spot staleness + EMA/spot tolerance ≤10%) — the strongest manipulation guard; the liquidation eligibility path uses `get_price` (EMA + staleness); only the seize-ratio calculation (`liquidate_calculate_seize_ctokens`) uses `get_spot_price` (spot staleness, no EMA), which is an intentional design choice affecting only liquidation incentive ratio, not protocol solvency. Pyth spot prices cannot be flash-loan manipulated in a single block (updates are pushed off-chain and on-chain separately), so no realistic attack path exploits this difference.
